name: Singapore
tagline: High-tech summits, fintech expos & sustainable urban venues
intro: Asia’s premier business crossroads featuring world-renowned convention venues like Marina Bay Sands and integrated tech infrastructure.
access: Direct flights from Delhi, roughly five and a half hours.
highlights: The most reliable logistics in Asia: transfers, venues and AV run to schedule, which matters when a client or the board is attending.
Excellent for conferences with external delegates and for educational and industrial visit programmes.
Compact and walkable, so a tight agenda loses very little time to movement.
planning_note: The highest cost per delegate in this list, and it rises sharply during major conferences and the Formula One weekend. Check the city's event calendar before committing.
